scene_description: A woman with long hair stands at a large airport window, holding a handbag and standing next to a rolling suitcase. She is looking out the window at an airplane flying in the sky.

questions.question: What is the big thing flying in the sky?
questions.evidence_hint: Look up in the top part of the picture, in the sky.

questions.question: What is the woman doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the woman's body — where is she facing and what is she doing?

questions.question: Where is the woman standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is right in front of the woman — what big thing is she next to?

questions.question: What is the woman carrying with her?
questions.evidence_hint: Look near the woman's hands and feet — what objects are with her?

questions.question: The woman has a suitcase and is at the airport. What might she be getting ready to do?
questions.sentence_frame: She might be getting ready to ___.
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the suitcase she has and the airplane outside — think about what people do at an airport.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been on an airplane or to an airport? What did you see?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you traveled or went somewhere far away.
